material.acceptance_criteria: On upstream tip 2d3cc5769e9c, the #status element carries role=status and aria-live=polite (or state changes pass through an existing live region), and a connecting-to-room transition is announced. Close stale if the upstream tip already carries it.
material.description:
js/client/play.html:156 renders
connecting
with no role and no aria-live, yet the line carries connection and room state (connecting, room name, peers N). Repo precedents set a live region for the same kind of status: js/client/modui.js:84 (aria-live polite panels, role log) and js/client/vendor/wireweave/src/feedback-form.js:36 (role status, aria-live polite). Evidence: codesearch literal aria-live over js/client returned 3 hits, none in play.html, widgets.js or hud.js (dispatch 1792858289348-4004-54390393f72f06a6); play.html status line from dispatch 1792858265590-3943-1c7a4d9eda8d0ac0. Caveat: the js/client checkout is 4 ahead and 9 behind upstream 2d3cc5769e9c and that search is stale_tree (complete false), so the upstream tip is unchecked. Principle: Nielsen, visibility of system status.

notes.note: Restored after a disposition write (prd-add overwrite wiped the row). Prior note, triage-hud-client-1 2026-10-24T16:41:04Z: play.html:156 status has no role or aria-live; setStatus in play.js writes it for load progress, stall and asset failures. Precedents: modui.js:84, vendor/wireweave/src/feedback-form.js:36.

Prior note, drain-gui-hud-client-1 2026-10-24T17:22:51Z: published f9cb36ce (#status role=status aria-live=polite). Witnessed on the live Pages build at 1280x720 and 375x667 (verify session, dispatch 1792893636924-6199-89c74a70315a89b2; re-run dispatch 1792893636924 family in the ledger under verify-DADA_CRIT_USE_NIELSEN).
